title: Senior Experience Designer
description:
Experience Designers with customer obsessed in developing human-centered experiences that provide personalized, clear, helpful, and inclusive digital plus human solutions for our customers. Experience designers consider the why, what, and how of product use to help identify where user needs intersect with business goals across the entire user journey. As an Experience Designer, you will:

• Leverage human-centered design methods (design-thinking, service design, research/insights etc.) to plan, create, and present persuasive, engaging, and strategic ideas that influence product roadmaps and demonstrate a solution's potential for success.

• Performs competitive analysis of direct/indirect competitors and monitors the marketplace for new trends to inform the research and design process.

• Translate business, contractual, technical, and user needs into end-to-end customer, employee, and 3rd-party experiences that are accessible, inclusive, and compliant.

• Designs omni-channel experiences that help customers meet their goals, are empathetic and easy to use, improve customer satisfaction, and drive deeper product adoption.

• Deliver experiences that have been validated through experimentation, testing and optimization.

• Conduct design within an agile environment and champion the integration of design across the entire release cycle (discover, deliver, and assess).

• Conform with reusability standards by leveraging and/or expanding the Design System and established platform capabilities.

• Manages across Enterprise users to define and deliver product performance goals (e.g., outcomes, customer experience, etc.).

• Collaborate with design peers and key stakeholders (Marketing, Brand, CX, etc.) to ensure artifacts and deliverables accurately represent and align to the Banking Brand, and create interconnectivity across customer, client, and employee touchpoints for all business segments

Requirements
  
  

**Basic Qualifications**
-User experience design experience

**Preferred Skills/Experience:-**

* Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance and ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators design systems, service blueprints, and reusability
* Demonstrates deep understanding of target customer through internal/external research (e.g., creation of personas, story maps, product chartering/mapping experience).
* Strong collaboration with product managers, software engineers, and agilists to execute product vision and roadmap .
* Facilitation of cross-functional human-centered design sessions to build empathy for users, create alignment on customer pain-points, and to identify continuous improvements for the product roadmap.

title: Graphic Designer – Product Infographics
description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

Wakefit is building one of a kind in India — a company pioneering e-commerce-led furniture manufacturing and design at scale. Within our Brand & Creative team at our Hosur facility, we are looking for a Graphic Designer who turns

* Product details into clear, beautiful infographics. Working with our CGI, photography, product and marketing teams, you will design feature, dimension and material infographics, marketplace A+ content and listing images using Adobe
* Photoshop, Illustrator or similar design tools, together with AI design tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney and Canva
* Magic Studio—helping customers understand every product at a glance.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE**

✓ Customers understand a product's features, dimensions and materials at a glance, without reading a spec sheet.

✓ Every infographic is accurate: measurements, materials, colours and claims match the approved product data.

✓ Infographics look consistent across categories and channels, in line with Wakefit's brand guidelines.

✓ Listing images and A+ content are delivered on schedule for Wakefit.co, Amazon, Flipkart and social channels.

✓ AI tools help you work faster while the product itself is never altered or misrepresented.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

▪ Design Product Infographics: Create feature callouts, dimension and size guides, material and finish explainers, comparison charts and how-it-works graphics for beds, sofas, dining sets, wardrobes, mattresses and more.

▪ Build Marketplace & Website Content: Design listing image sets and A+ / enhanced content modules to Wakefit.co, Amazon and Flipkart specifications (sizes, safe zones, text limits).

▪ Work from Renders & Photos: Use CGI renders and product photos from the visualisation studio as the base, and cut out, retouch and composite them cleanly in Photoshop.

▪ Create Vector Graphics in Illustrator: Draw icons, line diagrams, dimension drawings, exploded and layered views, and illustrated callouts that stay sharp at every size.

▪ Use AI Design Tools: Use Adobe Firefly (Generative Fill/Expand), Midjourney, Canva Magic Studio and similar tools to extend backgrounds, explore layouts and speed up production without changing the product.

▪ Turn Product Data into Clear Visuals: Read spec sheets, technical drawings and product briefs, and turn them into simple visual stories with clear, concise customer-facing copy.

▪ Check Accuracy Before Sign-Off: Verify every dimension, material, colour and claim against approved product data and physical samples before publishing.

▪ Keep the Brand Consistent: Follow Wakefit's typography, colour, iconography and layout guidelines, and help build reusable templates and icon libraries.

▪ Adapt for Every Channel: Resize and adapt designs for web, mobile, marketplaces, social posts and print collateral such as store and catalogue material.

▪ Collaborate & Take Feedback: Work with CGI artists, photographers, product designers and marketing on briefs, and close feedback within agreed timelines.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

▪ Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related creative field.

▪ 0–5 years of experience in graphic design, ideally in furniture, home décor, retail or D2C/e-commerce.

▪ A portfolio of infographics, product or e-commerce graphics and layout work (required).

▪ Working knowledge of design tools such as Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Figma or Canva.

▪ Hands-on experience with AI design tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney or Canva Magic Studio, used responsibly and accurately.

▪ Strong typography, layout and information-design skills: hierarchy, spacing, icon systems and readable copy at small sizes.

▪ Ability to read product spec sheets and technical drawings and present dimensions accurately.

▪ Understanding of marketplace image guidelines (Amazon, Flipkart) and correct export for web (sRGB, file size, resolution).

▪ Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple SKUs a week to deadlines.

▪ Shortlisted candidates will complete a short practical test: one product infographic and one A+ content module from a brief.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

★ Experience with packaging, catalogue or in-store print design.

★ Knowledge of furniture materials and finishes (wood, veneers, laminates, fabrics, leatherette, metal).

★ Experience building design templates or brand toolkits for high-volume production.

title: Instructional Designer and LMS Administrator
description:
**Company Description**
Ramraj Cotton, founded in 1983 by entrepreneur K.R. Nagarajan, is a leading brand in India’s traditional apparel segment, especially dhotis and white shirts across South India. The company is known for its consistent quality and extensive portfolio of cotton and white fabrics for traditional everyday wear. Over the years, Ramraj Cotton has grown into an integrated, retail-focused organisation that combines cultural heritage with modern retail practices. The brand is strengthening its presence in southern markets while expanding rapidly in northern India, including offerings in women’s traditional wear, towels, and athleisure.

**Role Description**
The Instructional Designer and LMS Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Tiruppur. The Instructional Designer will be responsible for designing engaging, business-focused learning solutions for Ramraj Cotton retail employees across stores, operations, sales, leadership, customer experience, and onboarding functions.

The role will transform business requirements into impactful learning experiences through classroom content, gamified digital learning modules (LMS), retail training toolkits, SOP-based learning, assessments, videos, simulations, and learning journeys aligned with the Ramraj retail culture and customer experience standards.

The individual will configure, manage, and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including user management, course uploads, reporting, and troubleshooting. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with functional teams to translate operational processes into training modules, updating content based on feedback and performance data, and ensuring training programs are accessible and easy to use for diverse employee groups. The role also includes monitoring learning outcomes, generating analytics and dashboards, and supporting trainers and managers in effectively using the LMS.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Needs Analysis and Training & Development to identify performance gaps and design appropriate learning interventions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Instructional Design and Curriculum Development to create structured, engaging, and culturally relevant training content.
* Candidates should possess skills in Learning Management and LMS administration to manage platform configuration, user access, course deployment, and reporting.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with retail, operations, HR, and leadership teams.
* Proficiency with e-learning authoring tools and basic multimedia design is beneficial.
* Experience in retail or apparel industry training environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Design, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced on-site environment.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**

Rajaganapathy Group of Companies is a semi-vertically integrated knitwear manufacturer in Tiruppur, India, established in 1996. The group began in offset printing and grew into full-scale garment manufacturing, fabric and collar knitting, and exports. With an annual capacity of over 2 million garments, we make men’s polos, T-shirts, women’s tops, kidswear, leggings, shorts and sleepwear for buyers in the USA, Canada, South Africa, Europe, Dubai and Australia. Our in-house offset printing division produces hangtags, wash care labels, size labels, stickers and other branding trims for our own garments and for export buyers.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Graphic Designer – Offset Printing & Trims role in Tiruppur. You’ll prepare and manage artwork for hangtags, wash care labels, size labels, price tickets, barcode stickers and packaging, and set it up for offset printing.

**Day-to-day work includes:**

* Updating existing designs for each order: sizes, colours, style numbers, barcodes, care symbols, fibre content, country of origin and buyer-specific text.
* Creating new designs for hangtags, labels and packaging, following buyer brand guidelines.
* Preparing print-ready files: correct dimensions, bleed, die lines, Pantone/CMYK colours and fonts outlined.
* Pre-press setup: arranging multiple tags and labels on a sheet (imposition), colour separation, and sending final files to the outside plate maker, then checking plates when they come back.
* Checking proofs against the buyer’s approved artwork and PO details before printing, so there are no wrong sizes, barcodes or care instructions.
* Working closely with merchandisers and the printing team to meet production deadlines.
* Keeping an organised artwork library, by buyer and season, so repeat orders can be updated quickly.

**Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and CorelDRAW.
* Knowledge of offset printing pre-press: imposition, colour separation, Pantone matching, and preparing files for outside plate makers.
* Experience with hangtags, wash care labels, stickers or packaging artwork.
* Understanding of barcodes (EAN/UPC) and care symbols used by export buyers.
* Strong attention to detail. One wrong size or barcode can hold up a whole shipment.
* Able to handle many small changes quickly and keep files well organised.
* Good communication with merchandising and print teams.
* A diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Printing Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in an apparel export or label printing company is an advantage.

title: Senior Network Solution Designer
description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Network Solution Designer to join the Access Networks organization. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise and service‑provider‑grade network infrastructures. The role requires deep technical expertise in routing, switching, network segmentation, L2/L3 services, wireless infrastructure, and architectural design. The candidate must operate effectively both independently and within distributed global teams.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Develop detailed High-Level and Low-Level Designs (HLD/LLD) for routing, switching, segmentation, Wi‑Fi, and NAC-enabled environments
* Design scalable enterprise and service provider network architecture
* Evaluate architecture changes, define resiliency requirements, and ensure alignment to Nokia standards.
* Analyze and resolve complex production network issues while ensuring reliable service operation for both Wired and Wireless network services.
* Administer service requests, execute network changes, and manage escalated incidents or priority incidents end-to-end.
* Collaborate with cross-technology teams to provide timely updates and coordinate incident resolutions.
* Identify root causes of network incidents and develop preventive actions while adhering to change management processes.
* Design and deploy wireless networks and authentication solutions, ensuring compliance with security best practices.
* Act as a L3 escalation point for L2 team members and mentor junior team members while staying updated on industry trends in network security technologies.
* Drive results and foster a strong customer focus in a dynamic, global team environment to maintain SLA compliance.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent with 12+ years of experience in network services within complex environments
* Deep knowledge in Network Routing, Switching, design/configuration in Local Area Networks.
* Proficiency in authentication protocols like RADIUS, TACACS, and LDAP
* Proficiency in OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VRRP and MPLS network protocols,VPLS, VPRN and VLL services
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and network technologies and Engineer network resilience, redundancy and optimized traffic flows.

**Nice-To-Have**

* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools for network management
* Experience in configuration and management of Clearpass & NAC
* WLAN knowledge specifically with Aruba Access Points and Controllers
* SROS Nokia Service Router Experience

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .
  
  
**Our recruitment process**
We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
  
  
The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Junior UXUI Designer
company: iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited
description:
**Company Description**
iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited is an algorithm development company focused on delivering innovative solutions for the oil and gas industry. The organization leverages data-driven approaches and advanced computational methods to solve complex industrial challenges. Team members collaborate closely with domain experts to design technology that improves efficiency, safety, and decision-making. The work environment supports learning, experimentation, and professional growth for individuals interested in applied technology and design.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Junior UXUI Designer role based in Velachery. Day-to-day tasks include creating wireframes, visual designs, and interactive prototypes, collaborating with product managers and developers to translate complex workflows into intuitive user experiences. The role involves conducting basic user research, organizing feedback, refining designs based on stakeholder input, and ensuring consistency in layout, typography, and visual elements. The Junior UXUI Designer will also assist in maintaining design systems and preparing assets for development handoff.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in UX and UI design principles, including wireframing, prototyping, and information architecture.
* Proficiency with common design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar).
* Ability to conduct and synthesize basic user research, usability feedback, and user testing outcomes.
* Attention to detail in visual design, layout, typography, and interaction design.
* Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with product, development, and domain experts.
* Relevant educational background in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Interest in learning about industrial domains such as oil and gas, and in designing for complex data-driven applications.
* Capability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and adapt to evolving project requirements in an on-site team environment.
